_comment: `p.js` and `m.js` are private members of the root `d.js`, and they import each other. `m.js` reads two keys of the namespace of `p.js` before the body of `p.js` runs. `export * from './c.cjs'` adds `fromC`, and `export * from './x.js'` adds `fromE` (`x.js` has dynamic exports, because it re-exports `e.cjs`). The two `__reExport` statements of `p.js` move before the body of `m.js`. The values are not constants, so Rolldown cannot inline them.
